_comment: Waveshare ESP32-S3-Touch-LCD-7: an ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8 (16MB quad flash, 8MB octal PSRAM) behind a 7-inch 800x480 parallel RGB panel with a GT911 touch controller. Pins and timings are the vendor's ESP-IDF demo (examples/ESP-IDF/09_lvgl_v9_demo/components/waveshare_rgb_lcd_port.h). Composed from the chip catalog; not yet verified on hardware.
_console: The board has no USB-UART bridge on its USB-C port: that is the S3's native USB-Serial/JTAG, which is the base target's default. UART0 (TX GPIO43 / RX GPIO44) is also brought out on the header.
_psram: N16R8 is 8MB octal PSRAM; the RGB panel's framebuffer (800x480x2 = 768KB, plus a back buffer) lives there.

display._pins: data0-4 = B3-B7, data5-10 = G2-G7, data11-15 = R3-R7. The backlight is EXIO2 on the CH422G, so no GPIO is named here.

touch._pins: Reset is EXIO1 on the CH422G; INT is GPIO4, which the binding also drives low across reset to fix the controller's I2C address at 0x5d.

expander._outputs: EXIO1 touch reset, EXIO2 backlight, EXIO3 panel reset, EXIO4 microSD chip-select, EXIO5 USB/CAN switch. initialOutputs 0x1e matches the vendor demo's steady state: resets released, backlight on, card deselected, USB selected.

_controls: The BOOT button is GPIO0, which the RGB bus uses as data6 (G3) on this board, so there is no launcher button.
